body:
Another way to do this would be to have [`Pagination.connect.refine`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/src/widgets/Pagination/connect.js#L41) simply return `state` unchanged when the page hasn't changed.

Then have [`Pagination.connect.transitionState`](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/v2/packages/react-instantsearch/src/widgets/Pagination/connect.js#L51) also return `prevState` unchanged in the case where `prevState === nextState`.

WDYT?
